import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im23 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0023.png'))
# Blue vase: find pixels where B > 150 and R < 50
mask_vase = (im23[:,:,2] > 150) & (im23[:,:,0] < 50)
coords = np.argwhere(mask_vase)
print('Vase bottom v:', coords[:,0].max(), 'u range:', coords[:,1].min(), coords[:,1].max())
print('Vase center u:', coords[:,1].mean())

# Stool: brown top/legs in foreground
# Let's inspect bottom of stool legs in obs23
mask_stool = (im23[:,:,0] > 60) & (im23[:,:,0] < 120) & (im23[:,:,1] > 60) & (im23[:,:,1] < 120) & (im23[:,:,2] > 70) & (im23[:,:,2] < 130)
# actually stool legs might be greyish/dark
"
